name: cli-dispatch-failure-exit
goal: Return a nonzero CLI status when an approved worker batch reports failure.

evidence: A worker can return failed without throwing, and the CLI currently prints that result with a zero process status.
The existing command registration case checks successful and idle dispatch but does not assert the CLI exit status of a failed worker result.
Record d46ff8eb6287 fails at 1aace31823 because a failed worker leaves exit status zero.
